pipeline: GitHub Actions -> GHCR -> Azure Container Apps

provenance.credentials_source: Container Apps secrets; not present in image or repo
provenance.seeded_data: two synthetic users in two distinct tenants, no business data

auth_write_path.meaning: DB write, validation and serialisation work in the deployed container

scale_to_zero.note: measured by polling the replica list until it went empty

cold_start.note: the request that revives a zero-replica app is the slow one; steady-state /health after warm-up is about 0.3s

not_demonstrated_here.rag_query: POST /query returns 500 because Qdrant is deliberately absent. The claim that a real RAG request returns a valid answer rests on the repository test suite against a real Qdrant, not on this deployment.
not_demonstrated_here.durable_checkpoints: The demo database is sqlite inside the container filesystem and is lost on scale-to-zero. Durable Postgres checkpoints are a repository-level claim proven by tests, not by this deployment.

known_defect.status: found on deploy, not yet reproduced in the repository test suite

cost_configuration.public_wording: Deployed on Azure Container Apps Consumption with scale-to-zero and usage kept within the available free grant during verification.
